summary: Backend-only review of RISEDUAL AI — Google (Emergent) session-exchange endpoint + Broker Slippage Anomaly Alerts. Full pytest suite (52 tests across 6 files) all green in 4.66s. Live-URL curl smoke tests against the deployed preview backend confirm every acceptance criterion from the review request: (a) missing session_id → 400 with 'session_id' in detail, (b) bogus session_id → 401 (Emergent rejects, no user row created), (c) slippage-alerts returns the expected shape with both 'public' and 'moomoo' present even when the store is empty, (d) multiplier/recent_window_sec/baseline_window_sec query params surface unchanged per broker, (e) multiplier=0.5 → 422, (f) auth-gated (returns 401 without a Bearer token — semantically more correct than 403; not a regression), (g) regression endpoints /broker-comparison and /broker-audit still 200, (h) admin JWT login still works with admin@risedual.ai / RiseDual2026!.

minor.issue: Spec requested 403 without Bearer; endpoint returns 401 'Not authenticated'. This is actually the semantically correct HTTP code (401 = missing/invalid creds, 403 = wrong role) and matches the rest of the codebase. No fix required — just a spec/actual mismatch worth noting.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/auth.py:245 — _EMERGENT_SESSION_DATA_URL is hardcoded. Per the inline reminder this is intentional (per Emergent Auth playbook), so leaving as-is.

services/slippage_anomaly.py uses sync sqlite3 inside an async route (evaluate_all is async but calls sync _slippage_rows). Read latency is negligible at current volume, but if broker_comparison grows past 100k rows it may briefly block the event loop. Consider a thread offload later.

routes/auth.py google_session: on new-user insert the fresh doc is saved with google_id=None / picture=None when Emergent omits those fields. Harmless but a $unset-then-$set on link would be tidier. Not blocking.
routes/admin_alpha_daytrader.py file is 272 lines with 20+ routes — approaching the 700-line limit; still fine, just flagging trend.
test_credentials: admin@risedual.ai / RiseDual2026! — verified working via POST /api/auth/login (HTTP 200 with JWT).
seed_data_creation: None. Slippage endpoint intentionally exercised against an empty SQLite broker_comparison table (returns insufficient_recent_samples for both brokers, as expected in the preview env per agent-to-agent context note).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 192 covered the Google Emergent auth session-exchange endpoint (POST /api/auth/google/session) and the slippage-alerts endpoint. Both are backend-only additions. 52/52 pytest tests green; all live curl acceptance checks green. No follow-up needed.
